description: This file defines a Java interface 'AuthGroupRepository' that extends Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide database access methods related to 'AuthGroup' entities, specifically including a custom method to find groups by username.

classes.name: AuthGroupRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for AuthGroup entities, providing CRUD operations and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a list of AuthGroup instances associated with a given username.
